title: Dead load template
description: A template of a build-up of permanent loads (calc/domains/dead_load_templates.py, issue #111, REQ-010): one of the eight Woodcore ships in calc/libraries/dead-load-templates.json (`templates`), or one of the engineer's own, «Mes modèles», a file each in %APPDATA%\Woodcore\dead-load-templates\. Its layers are a build-up's, dead-load-source 2.0, checked as one (dead_load_source.check_source); «Créer depuis ce modèle» copies them into a source of the project.

id.description: Woodcore's: lignum-<chapter>-<table or figure>; the engineer's: t-<8 digits>, the file's name.

kind.description: What the build-up is, for the cards' grouping.

names.description: Its name by language (fr, de, en): Woodcore's in the three, the engineer's in the one he wrote it in.

reference.description: Where it is read: the book, the table or figure, the page.

assumptions.description: What the template supposes that its source does not give, by language.

book_weight.description: The weight of the whole build-up its source gives, shown beside the sum as a check; null where it gives none.

layers.description: The layers top to bottom, as dead-load-source 2.0 writes them.

chosen.description: The retained value the build-up carried when the engineer kept it as a template; null for the tenth above the sum.
